name: Louis Arneb
description: Louis Arneb is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult representing the Satiation aspect of Gluttony. Unlike her brothers Lye and Roy who roamed the physical world, Louis dwelled in the Hall of Memories within Od Lagna, consuming memories and lives in an obsessive quest for happiness until her encounter with Subaru's Return by Death drove her into profound terror and madness during Arc 6.
